decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix relies on consumer food knowledge outside the firm's chemical and engineering absorptive capacity, so it cannot effectively interpret results and is unlikely to improve, warranting a drop.
The modular waste-to-energy extensions draw directly on the firm's existing waste-to-energy expertise, allowing it to assimilate feedback and refine the models, so it should be kept.
As a flagship waste-oil-to-energy plant close to the firm's core capabilities, its strong absorptive capacity supports ongoing learning and improvement, so it should be kept.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel flagship is closely related to the firm's established processes, enabling effective evaluation and further development, so it should be kept.
